verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions human annotation queues or any way to route outputs to human reviewers for labeling. Weave documents collecting feedback on traces, automated signals that tag agent turns, and LLM-judge scorers, but these are adjacent features, not a queue-based human review workflow. Annotation queues are a fair axis for an LLM evaluation and observability platform, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling
